title: lane r5 SE: absolute-green standing suite deadlocks on pre-existing failures
description: Lane round 5. Lens: SE (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: no-regression is a delta property implemented as an absolute gate — any unrelated red blocks every fix, and two independent pre-existing failures deadlock each other (bundling forbidden, no pre-publish waiver, broken-surface clause inapplicable to a running-but-failing suite). Citations verified: contract:64 with :81. Proposed: resolved-candidate (delta semantics: the standing suite runs at baseline and HEAD and the gate compares — no test failing at HEAD that passed at baseline; pre-existing failures neither block nor excuse).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the standing suite is a delta — runs at baseline and HEAD, gate compares, no test failing at HEAD that passed at baseline; pre-existing failures neither block nor excuse; the two-standing-failures deadlock dissolves. Revision: gate bullet.
